quote.text: It’s silly to try to escape other people’s faults. They are inescapable. Just try to escape your own.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Focus on your own growth and self-improvement as a parent; when you address your own faults, you create a nurturing environment that models accountability for your children.
    • Recognize that you cannot shield your family from the imperfections of the world—but by continuously refining your character, you empower both yourself and your loved ones to thrive amidst life’s challenges.
  • Leadership
    • True leadership is paved with authenticity and introspection; instead of critiquing the shortcomings of others, seek to understand and mend your own, thereby inspiring trust and respect in your team.
    • By prioritizing your own development, you set a standard of integrity and resilience that encourages those around you to embrace their own growth and accountability.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, the focus should be on refining your process and approach; rather than getting bogged down by every external issue, concentrate on iterating and improving your own strategies.
    • Embracing self-improvement fosters a culture of constructive feedback and proactive problem-solving, ultimately leading to a more cohesive and adaptive product development environment.
